## Independent review of the draft
A reviewer found the following defects:
- D1 [Theorem B, Step 2, one-empty-pool branch: “the total number of cuts is |Z|≤n−1”]: If the nonempty set among P,Q is a singleton, then |Z|=(n+1)-1=n, so the asserted bound is false.
- D2 [Theorem B, Step 3: “δ(L)≤max L≤∑L”]: The leftover family L can be empty when D=0, making max L undefined; for example, with n=1, A=(1/2,1/2), P={1}, and Q={2}, cancellation leaves L=∅. This quantified degenerate case is not handled.

Revise the draft above into a complete rigorous proof, addressing every listed defect. Output the full revised write-up only.
